meta.title: refactor(connector): split connector implementations into optional features
meta.body_summary: Split connector implementations into optional Cargo features to reduce compilation time when not needed, addressing community request for better connector modularity.

perf_labels.notes: Large Rust conditional compilation refactor could not pass build despite multiple fix attempts; PR closed after maintainer-reported compile failures.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 5302 changed lines across 22 files, this is a large-scale refactor, primarily restructuring the connector crate with new feature flags. The closure is consistent with the unresolved compilation issues for a change this size.

review_details.concern_detail: Maintainer xxchan reported compilation failures repeatedly; Copilot attempted multiple fixes but the build remained broken, partly due to protobuf code generation issues.
review_details.performance_claim: Reduce compilation time by making heavy connector dependencies optional behind feature flags, enabling faster development builds.
review_details.rejection_signals: Compilation failures repeatedly observed; no evidence of successful build; PR closed after inactivity.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Copilot failed to produce a compiling refactor of a large Rust connector crate with complex conditional compilation, suggesting difficulty with Rust feature flag intricacies and build system quirks in a large monorepo.

detection_detail.code_reading: xxchan checked buildkite compilation logs and identified failures.
detection_detail.ci_auto: CI label 'ci/run-e2e-iceberg-tests' added, but no indication of successful CI runs.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: Compilation errors were visible in CI logs, but network/firewall issues hindered Copilot's ability to fully rebuild.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: After multiple failed fix attempts, the PR was closed without merge, likely due to persistent build errors and inactivity.

core_change_summary.description: Added Cargo feature flags (sink-iceberg, sink-clickhouse, etc.) to make 8 connector implementations optional, using cfg_if! and dummy implementations to allow conditional compilation. Moved implementation code into imp.rs files inside feature-gated mod.rs, updated Cargo.toml with optional dependencies and all-sinks default feature.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Most churn is in the Iceberg sink refactor (2400+ lines) and connector module restructure.
change_trajectory: Add feature flags for Iceberg, ClickHouse, MongoDB, BigQuery sinks.
Add feature flags for DynamoDB, ElasticSearch, OpenSearch sinks.
Fix compilation issues with conditional imports and macros.
Multiple subsequent commits to fix build environment and remaining conditional compilation errors.
Final commit enables all-connectors by default for backward compatibility.

review_signals.summary: Reported compilation failed and asked to check buildkite log.
Fixed conditional compilation issues and explained approach with dummy implementations.

review_signals.action_taken: Copilot noted protobuf generation issues but made further attempts.

review_signals.summary: Reported that protobuf code generation failure is unrelated to connector feature flags and a pre-existing environment issue.
Claimed compilation resolved; successfully isolated heavy dependencies behind feature flags.

collaboration_trajectory: Copilot opened PR with large feature flag refactor.
Maintainer reported compilation failure; Copilot attempted fixes across multiple commits.
Build errors persisted, partly due to protobuf generation and network issues.
Maintainer repeatedly requested retry, but no successful build achieved.
PR was closed after ~6 days without merge.
